issue: The caption states the canonical prefill arithmetic intensity as "~0.2K FLOP/byte" and then claims this point is "well to the right of the ~295 ridge" in the "compute-bound regime". This is internally false: 0.2K = 200 FLOP/byte is LESS than the 295 FLOP/byte ridge, so a 200 FLOP/byte point lies on the memory-bound side, not the compute-bound side. It also contradicts the figure on the same page, whose prefill marker (blue triangle) is drawn at x ≈ 10^4 FLOP/byte, and it contradicts the book's own arithmetic: prefill FLOPs ≈ 2·N·L = 2·70e9·9200 ≈ 1.29e15, weight bytes ≈ 2·N = 1.4e11, giving intensity ≈ 9.2K FLOP/byte (≈ the 9.2K input length, since each weight is read once per token) — matching the figure, not the caption.
evidence: Caption text: "(1) Regime: arithmetic intensity places the canonical prefill point ~0.2K FLOP/byte, well to the right of the ~295 ridge — so prefill sits in the compute-bound regime". Figure: prefill triangle at x≈10^4; bottom box "H100 SXM, BF16 dense: 989 TFLOPS peak, 3.35 TB/s HBM3 → ridge at 295 FLOP/byte"; red dashed ridge at ~295. Recomputation: 2·70e9·9200 / (2·70e9) = 9200 FLOP/byte ≈ 9.2K, which is > 295. Note 200 < 295, so the caption's "right of ridge / compute-bound" cannot hold for its own number.
acceptance_test: Replace "~0.2K FLOP/byte" with the value consistent with both the figure's prefill marker and the 2NL/weight-bytes derivation (≈9K FLOP/byte, i.e. ~10^4). After the change, verify (a) the stated number is greater than 295 so "well to the right of the ~295 ridge" and "compute-bound regime" are true, and (b) the figure's prefill marker x-position matches the stated number. Confirm the decode value (~1 FLOP/byte, memory-bound) is unchanged and still < 295.

issue: The caption gives the single-H100 theoretical peak as "0.980 PFLOPS", but the figure's own top label ("989 TFLOPS") and bottom box ("989 TFLOPS peak") state 989 TFLOPS = 0.989 PFLOPS (and the house convention pins FP16/BF16 dense at 989 TFLOPS). 0.980 PFLOPS = 980 TFLOPS, a 9 TFLOPS internal inconsistency on the same page. The capacity conclusion (1.19 PFLOPS demand > peak) is unaffected, but the number should match the figure.
evidence: Caption: "exceeding the compared single-H100 theoretical peak (0.980 PFLOPS)". Figure top label: "989 TFLOPS"; figure bottom box: "989 TFLOPS peak". 989 TFLOPS = 0.989 PFLOPS ≠ 0.980 PFLOPS.
acceptance_test: Change 0.980 to 0.989 (or 0.99) so the caption matches the figure's 989 TFLOPS; re-verify that the stated 1.19 PFLOPS demand still exceeds the corrected peak.
